items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Sure. I got to play with him then and that's when I really found out, you know.

ctx.x: Sure. I got to play with him then and that's when I really found out, you know. He has a solo on the record I sang on, "Do You Believe in Love at Sight?"
He has a record -- he has a solo on there. And Bennie Carter made that arrangement, by the way.
